definitions.activity: Evaluation-only true source gains undergo exactly the configured baseline subtraction and smoothing; absolute value normalized separately by each source/rank peak. Active >= strong, inactive <= weak. Entry requires one strong rank and all other ranks weak; mixed/gray frames excluded. Rank uses its own source. Masks never enter fitting or prediction.
definitions.active_scores: Per-frame class scores over supported strong-active trial-frames only; M0/M1/M2 six-way conditionals. M3 six-way conditional is exactly M2, so not repeated. NLL from log domain, Brier=sum over six classes, circular error=min(|pred-true|,6-|pred-true|) location steps.
definitions.ece: 10 fixed equal-width max-confidence bins, top-label calibration only; not animal confidence. All frames correlated; no iid significance or animal inference.
definitions.inactive: M0/M1/M2 event is conditional max location probability >=.9. M3 location event is max of six JOINT probabilities >=.9; separate M3 presence event is P(content)>train-readout-OOF baseline q95 threshold. These are different events, not interchangeable accuracy measures.
definitions.baseline: SIMULATION-ONLY assumption diagnostic. Prestimulus can contain imagined content; do not apply this null as a real absence label. Baseline-like null is not a verified absence model. Its prior .5 is a design choice, not calibrated true prevalence. Baseline-only and post-first-onset inactive subsets are reported separately; baseline rejection does not guarantee post-onset rejection.
definitions.detection: AUROC/AP label strong-active versus weak-inactive, exclude gray. M0/M1/M2 use max conditional posterior as diagnostic score, not a learned absence detector. M3 uses P(content). AP no-skill reference is subset active prevalence. Curves may be decimated for display; scalar metrics use all observations.
definitions.binary_presence_scores: Binary Brier=mean(Pcontent-active_indicator)^2 (not the two-class summed variant); binary NLL uses logsumexp of the six joint location logits or log null posterior without clipping. Evaluated on active+inactive support; depends on gain thresholds and true prevalence. Prior .5 is not necessarily that prevalence.
definitions.operating_point: At exactly the frozen strict P(content)>train q95 decision, report active TPR, correctly emitted location fraction of ALL active rows, and location accuracy among emitted active rows. False-alarm reductions must be read together with these power metrics.
definitions.original_windows: Original six Entry/own-Rank windows are also scored for M0/M1/M2, without truth-activity masking, preserving direct comparison to the previous version.
definitions.threshold: Strict P(content)>q95; threshold estimated from readout-only inner crossfit conditional on fixed outer-training upstream, not fully nested upstream refitting. No promised 5% held-out/OOD FPR.
definitions.coverage_risk: For each threshold, emit a location if max conditional (M0-M2) or P(content) (M3) exceeds threshold. Coverage=emitted/all active+inactive supported observations. Risk=wrong class OR emitted on inactive among emitted. All unique confidence cutpoints are computed with strict > and intact ties; at most 250 deterministic points retained for display. No threshold chosen using this evaluation.
definitions.display: Original row/trial 0, known outer fold 4. First three heatmaps conditional six-way; M3 six JOINT locations (sum=Pcontent), separate presence/null plot. All heatmaps .2..1; values below .2 bottom color; no truth gating.

packaging_note: Compact report omits only sampled coverage-risk and ROC/PR plotting coordinates. Every scalar score, threshold criterion, operating point, sensitivity and original-window metric is retained. Full metrics.json is regenerated by run_optimized.py; plotted curves are retained in PNGs.
